title: The Invoices import lists the columns Line Title and Line Description
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Settings.
custom_steps: 1. Click Invoices under Data Import in the Settings left menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Invoices import page opens; its on-screen column list names "Line Title" and "Line Description" next to each other, after Item and before Tech Story.
  • The column list nowhere says "What are you doing" or "Why are you doing it".
  • Data Import has no separate work order import: Invoices is the import that carries these two columns.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports)

  • S4-R2: “The historical invoice import's two columns (Administration → Invoices) are named "*Line Title" and "Line Description", replacing "*Line Title - What are you doing" and "Line Description - Why are you doing it".”
  • S4-R6: “The downloadable sample file and the on-screen column list both show the new names.”
  • S4-R1: “Withdrawn. There is no separate work order import. The only live import carrying these columns is Administration → Invoices, which writes to the imported work order history and is covered by S4-R2. The column names this requirement renamed exist only in code nothing calls, and nothing ships for them.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “The historical invoice import (Administration → Invoices) renames its two columns to match, and still accepts the old column names, so no spreadsheet a shop already holds stops working. It is the only live import that carries these columns.”
  • Surfaces: “Historical invoice import columns | *Line Title - What are you doing / Line Description - Why are you doing it | *Line Title / Line Description, old names still accepted”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-11257, and bug SV-11850 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10133, Nemanja Djuric, 8 Oct 2026 (Ready for QA testing): “The on-screen column list says "Line Title, Line Description".”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
